title: Persist session-bind events so doctor can report when the control plane last bound a session
outcome: Each control session bind leaves a durable record, so doctor's real-use report can state the last bind time exactly rather than the last session activity time.
acceptance: A session bind persists one durable record (for example a control_operation_results row with operation session_bind and its time), and doctor prints the latest bind time, or "not recorded before this build"

The extra write's latency is measured on the bind path and stays within the existing budgets; import, integrity checks and older-build behaviour are judged under the full-store migration rule and presented to Greg if a migration is needed
